intro.me: Zgrade, predmeti i priče Gusinja i Prokletija u 3D. Okrenite ih prstom, držite ih na kocki ili ih postavite u prirodnoj veličini u prostor oko sebe.
intro.en: Buildings, objects and stories of Gusinje and Prokletije in 3D. Turn them with a finger, hold them on the cube, or place them at real size in the room around you.

description.me: Predmeti svakodnevnog života i rada: posuđe, alati za kosidbu i žetvu, samar i kola.
description.en: Objects of everyday life and work: vessels, tools for mowing and harvest, a pack saddle and a cart.

description.me: Kule, kuće, džamije i javne zgrade Gusinja.
description.en: Towers, houses, mosques and public buildings of Gusinje.

description.me: Ibrik je metalna posuda s drškom i poklopcem, u koju se sipala voda za pranje ruku i lica. U kućama Gusinja stajao je uz leđen (lavor), pa se gostu i ukućanima polivalo po rukama prije i poslije jela, a voda iz ibrika služila je i za abdest.
description.en: An ibrik is a metal vessel with a handle and a lid, filled with water for washing hands and face. In Gusinje homes it stood beside a basin (leđen): water was poured over the hands of guests and family before and after meals, and it was also used for the ritual washing before prayer.

description.me: Sječivo kose, kovano od gvožđa. Nasađivalo se na dugo drveno kosište, a prije kosidbe otkivalo se čekićem na babici i oštrilo brusom koji je kosac nosio za pasom. Kosom se kosila trava za sijeno na livadama i katunima ispod Prokletija.
description.en: A forged iron scythe blade. It was fixed to a long wooden shaft; before mowing it was hammered thin on a small anvil and sharpened with a whetstone the mower carried at his belt. Scythes cut the grass for hay on the meadows and summer pastures below Prokletije.

description.me: Još jedna kosa iz zbirke, s dugim drvenim kosištem i dvije ručice. Oblik sječiva, kosišta i ručica razlikovao se od majstora do majstora i prilagođavao se visini i ruci kosca.
description.en: Another scythe from the collection, with a long wooden shaft and two grips. The shape of the blade, shaft and grips varied from smith to smith and was fitted to the height and hand of the mower.

description.me: Srpom se žnjelo žito, rukovet po rukovet, a snopovi su se vezali i slagali u krstine da se osuše. Žetva je bila zajednički posao porodice i komšija.
description.en: The sickle was used to reap grain one handful at a time; the sheaves were tied and stacked to dry. Harvest was shared work for the family and the neighbours.

description.me: Samar je drveno tovarno sedlo koje se stavljalo na konja ili mazgu. Po strmim planinskim stazama, gdje kola nijesu mogla proći, na samaru se prenosilo sve: drva, sijeno, žito i so, sir i kajmak s katuna.
description.en: A samar is a wooden pack saddle for a horse or mule. On steep mountain paths where no cart could pass, everything travelled on it: firewood, hay, grain and salt, and cheese and kajmak brought down from the summer pastures.

description.me: Drveni točak sa žbicama, glavčinom i obručem bio je djelo vještog kolara, a gvozdeni obruč navlačio je kovač dok je bio vruć. Kola su se koristila u ravnici oko Gusinja, za sijeno, drva i odlazak na pazar.
description.en: A wooden wheel with spokes, a hub and a rim was the work of a skilled wheelwright; the iron tyre was fitted by the smith while still hot. Carts were used on the flat land around Gusinje for hay, firewood and trips to the market.

description.me: Ovo je privremeni, pojednostavljeni model za isprobavanje aplikacije. Detaljan 3D model kule i njena priča dodaju se uskoro.
description.en: This is a temporary, simplified model for trying out the app. The detailed 3D model of the tower and its story are coming soon.
